item.title: Couple arrested in Lagos for faking kidnap, extorting N10 million from families
item.description: A Lagos-based husband and wife, identified simply as Fred and Goodness, have been arrested for allegedly orchestrating a fake kidnapping and extorting N10 million from their relatives and associates. item.title: Europa League: 12 teams eliminated from competition [Full list]
item.description: The 12 teams that are eliminated from this season’s Europa League are confirmed. This follows the conclusion of the group phase on Thursday night. item.title: Court order: Wike moves to commit FCTA striking workers to prison
item.description: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Barrister Nyesom Wike has applied for an order of the National Industrial Court to commit the striking workers of the Federal Capital Territory Administration (FCTA) to prison over their alleged disobedience to order of the court. item.title: It’s political deception – Shehu dismisses Kano rail project
item.description: Mahdi Shehu has dismissed the proposed Kano Metropolitan Rail Project, describing it as a political deception. He revealed this in a post shared on X on Thursday. He argued that the rail project does not exist in official government plan, insisting that there is no provision for it in the 2026 budget proposals.
